import scala.io.StdIn
import scala.annotation.tailrec

object Main extends App {
  val n = StdIn.readInt
  val a = StdIn.readLine.split(" ").map(_.toLong)

  val init1 = if(a.head <= 0) 1 - a.head else 0
  val ans1 = a.tail./:(a.head + init1, init1.abs)((acc,i) => {
    val (bsum, bcnt) = acc
    val sum = bsum + i
    val cnt = if(bsum < 0 && sum < 0) 1 - sum
    else if(bsum > 0 && sum > 0) -1 - sum
    else if(sum == 0) if(bsum < 0) 1 else -1
    else 0
    // if(bcnt+cnt.abs < 0) println(i + " " + sum + " " + cnt)
    (sum+cnt, bcnt+cnt.abs)
  })._2

  val init2 = if(a.head < 0) 0 else -1 - a.head
  val ans2 = a.tail./:(a.head + init2, init2.abs)((acc,i) => {
    val (bsum, bcnt) = acc
    val sum = bsum + i
    val cnt = if(bsum < 0 && sum < 0) 1 - sum
    else if(bsum > 0 && sum > 0) -1 - sum
    else if(sum == 0) if(bsum < 0) 1 else -1
    else 0
    // if(bcnt+cnt.abs < 0) println(i + " " + sum + " " + cnt)
    (sum+cnt, bcnt+cnt.abs)
  })._2

  println(math.min(ans1, ans2))
}

int a[100010];
int sum[100010];
int sum1[100010];
int n;

int main(){
	cin>>n;
	sum[0]=0;
	int ans1=0,ans2=0;
	for (int i=1;i<=n;i++) {
		cin>>a[n];
		sum[i]=sum[i-1]+a[n];
		if (i!=1) {
			if (sum[i]*sum[i-1]>=0){
				if (sum[i]>=0) {
					ans1+=sum[i]+1;
					sum[i]=-1;
				}
				else {
					ans1+=1-sum[i];
					sum[i]=1;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	for (int i=n;i>0;i--) {
		int x=n-i+1;
		sum1[x]=sum1[x-1]+a[i];
		if (i!=n){
			if (sum1[x]*sum1[x-1]>=0){
				if (sum1[x]>=0){
					ans2+=sum1[x]+1;
					sum1[x]=-1;
				}
				else {
					ans2+=1-sum1[x];
					sum1[x]=1;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	cout<<min(ans1,ans2)<<endl;
//	cout<<ans1;
	return 0;
}

long long a[100010];
long long sum[100010];
long long sum1[100010];
long long n;

long long main(){
	cin>>n;
	sum[0]=0;
	long long ans1=0,ans2=0;
	for (long long i=1;i<=n;i++) {
		cin>>a[n];
		sum[i]=sum[i-1]+a[n];
		if (i!=1) {
			if (sum[i]*sum[i-1]>=0){
				if (sum[i]>=0) {
					ans1+=sum[i]+1;
					sum[i]=-1;
				}
				else {
					ans1+=1-sum[i];
					sum[i]=1;
				}
			}
		}
	}
//	for (long long i=1;i<=n;i++) cout<<sum[i];
	sum1[0]=0;
	for (long long i=n;i>0;i--) {
		long long x=n-i+1;
		sum1[x]=sum1[x-1]+a[i];
		if (i!=n){
			if (sum1[x]*sum1[x-1]>=0){
				if (sum1[x]>=0){
					ans2+=sum1[x]+1;
					sum1[x]=-1;
				}
				else {
					ans2+=1-sum1[x];
					sum1[x]=1;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	cout<<min(ans1,ans2)<<endl;
//	cout<<ans1;
	return 0;
}

    where go _ [] = 0

            | sum < 0 = let k = max 0 (1-sum-x) in k + go (sum+x+k) xs
            | sum > 0 = let k = max 0 (sum+x+1) in k + go (sum+x-k) xs

isSameSign :: Int -> Int -> Bool

diff :: (Num a) => a -> a -> a
diff a b = abs $ a - b

generateFirst :: [Int] -> [Int] -> (Int, Int)
generateFirst = (foldl' fn (0, 0) .) . zip 
    where
        fn (acc, cost) (sign, x) = if (isSameSign (acc + x) sign)
                                   then (acc + x, cost)
                                   else (sign, cost + (diff (acc + x) sign))

negativeFirst :: [Int] -> Int
negativeFirst = snd . generateFirst (cycle [-1, 1])

positiveFirst :: [Int] -> Int
positiveFirst = snd . generateFirst (cycle [1, -1])

solve :: Int -> U.Vector Int -> Int

solveNP xs = fst $ U.ifoldl' step (0, 0) xs
  where
    step (!acc, !s) i x
        | i .&. 1 == 1 = if s + x > 0 then (acc, s + x) else (acc + (1 - (s + x)), 1)
        | otherwise = if s + x < 0 then (acc, s + x) else (acc + s + x + 1, -1)

solvePN xs = fst $ U.ifoldl' step (0, 0) xs
  where
    step (!acc, !s) i x
        | i .&. 1 == 0 = if s + x > 0 then (acc, s + x) else (acc + (1 - (s + x)), 1)
        | otherwise = if s + x < 0 then (acc, s + x) else (acc + s + x + 1, -1)

rep n = flip MS.mapM_ (stream 0 n)
{-# INLINE rep #-}
rev :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()
rev !n = flip MS.mapM_ (streamR 0 n)
{-# INLINE rev #-}
stream :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream !l !r = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream #-}
streamR :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
streamR !l !r = MS.Stream step (r - 1) where { step x | x >= l = return $ MS.Yield x (x - 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] streamR #-}
stream' :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream' !l !r !d = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + d) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream' #-}

lowerBoundM :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> (Int -> m Bool) -> m Int
lowerBoundM low high p = go low high where { go !low !high | high <= low = return high | otherwise = p mid >>= bool (go (mid + 1) high) (go low mid) where { mid = low + unsafeShiftRL (high - low) 1}}
{-# INLINE lowerBoundM #-}
upperBoundM :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> (Int -> m Bool) -> m Int
upperBoundM low high p = do { flg <- p high; if flg then return high else subtract 1 <$!> lowerBoundM low high (fmap not . p)}
{-# INLINE upperBoundM #-}
lowerBound :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Bool) -> Int
lowerBound low high p = runIdentity (lowerBoundM low high (return . p))
{-# INLINE lowerBound #-}
upperBound :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Bool) -> Int
upperBound low high p = runIdentity (upperBoundM low high (return . p))
{-# INLINE upperBound #-}

solve :: [Int] -> (Int,Int)
solve (a:as) | a /= 0 = foldl' worker (a,0) as
             | otherwise = let a' = head as
                               s = if a' > 0 then -1 else 1
                            in foldl' worker (s,1) as

worker :: (Int,Int) -> Int -> (Int,Int)
worker (s,n) a | s*s' < 0 = (s',n)
               | s*s' >= 0 = let da = if s > 0 then -(s'+1)
                                               else -s'+1
                              in (s'+da, n + abs da)
    where s' = s + a

  sum = 0

  a.each do |x|

    r *= -1 # 次項の符号をセット                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  end

      count += sum.abs + 1
      sum = prev_sum > 0 ? -1 : 1

    else: A[1] = 1
    result += 1
  elif rev:
    if A[1] < 0:
      result += abs(1 - A[1])
      A[1] = 1  
    elif A[1] > 0:
      result += abs(-1 - A[1])
      A[1] = -1
  C[1] = A[1]
  for i in 2 .. N:
    C[i] = C[i - 1] + A[i]
    if C[i - 1] * C[i] < 0:
      continue
    else:
      if C[i] < 0:

        C[i] = 1

        C[i] = 1
      elif C[i] == 0 and C[i - 1] > 0:
        result += abs(-1 - 0)
        C[i] = -1

proc f(A: seq[int], rev: bool): int =
  result = 0
  var A = A
  var C = newSeq[int](N + 2)
  if A[1] == 0:
    if rev: A[1] = -1
    else: A[1] = 1
    result += 1
  elif rev:
    if A[1] < 0:
      A[1] = 1
      result += abs(1 - A[1])
    elif A[1] > 0:
      A[1] = -1
      result += abs(-1 - A[1])
  C[1] = A[1]
  for i in 2 .. N:
    C[i] = C[i - 1] + A[i]
    if C[i - 1] * C[i] < 0:
      continue
    else:
      if C[i] < 0:
        result += abs(1 - C[i])
        C[i] = 1
      elif C[i] == 0 and C[i - 1] < 0:
        result += abs(1 - 0)
        C[i] = 1
      elif C[i] == 0 and C[i - 1] > 0:
        result += abs(-1 - 0)
        C[i] = -1
      else:
        result += abs(-1 - C[i])
        C[i] = -1

            sigma += diff
            operations += diff
        if prev_sign == '+':

def seq(prog,first_Ev=False):
    sign = -1 if first_Ev else 1
    if sign * prog[0] > 0:
        answer = 0
        result = prog[0]
    else:
        answer = abs(sign - prog[0])
        result = sign
    for i in prog[1:]:
        sign *= -1
        result += i
        if result * sign <= 0:
            answer += abs(sign - result)
            result = sign
    return answer

def solve(a):
    s, res = 0, 0
    for i, ai in enumerate(a):
        ss = s
        ss += ai
        if ss == 0:
            ss = 1 if s < 0 else -1
            res += 1
        else:

                res += abs(ss) + 1
                ss = 1
            if s > 0 and ss > 0:

                ss = -1
        s = ss
    return res

    flag = 1
    acc = 0
    ans = 0
    #while loop O(n)
    while len(seq) > 0:
        a = seq[0]
        acc += a

        if flag > 0:
            if acc <= 0:
                ans += 1-acc
                acc = 1
        if flag < 0:
            if acc >= 0:
                ans += 1+acc
                acc = -1
        #print(seq, acc, ans)
        seq.pop(0)
        flag = flag * (-1)
    return ans

def osilate(seq):
    flag = 1
    acc = 0
    ans = 0
    #while loop O(n)
    for i in range(len(seq)):
        a = seq[i]
        acc += a
        flag = i%2

        if flag == 0:
            if acc <= 0:
                ans += 1-acc
                acc = 1
        if flag == 1:
            if acc >= 0:
                ans += 1+acc
                acc = -1
        #print(seq, acc, acc)
        flag = flag * (-1)
    return ans

def solve(A):
    # A[0] > 0 となるように
    cum = 0
    cnt = 0
    for x in A:
        if cum <= 0:
            # positiveにしたい
            cum += x
            if cum <= 0:
                cnt += (1 - cum)
                cum = 1
        else:
            # negativeにしたい
            cum += x
            if cum >= 0:
                cnt += (1 + cum)
                cum = -1
    return cnt

def osilate(seq):
    flag = 1
    acc = 0
    ans = 0
    while len(seq) > 0:

        a = seq[0]
        acc += a

        if flag > 0:
            if acc <= 0:
                ans += 1-acc
                acc = 1
        if flag < 0:
            if acc >= 0:
                ans += 1+acc
                acc = -1
        #print(seq, acc, ans)
        seq.pop(0)
        flag = flag * (-1)
    return ans
